metadata.dcterms:title: THE COLORED JONES POLYNOMIAL AND THE A-POLYNOMIAL FOR TWIST KNOTS
metadata.dcterms:creator: TAKATA, TOSHIE
metadata.dcterms:abstract: @We show that for a twist knot, the A-polynomial can be obtained from recur- rences for the summand in Masbaum’s formula of the colored Jones polynomial. Our result supports the AJ conjecture due to S.Garoufalidis.
